name: phil/idempotency
description: Each operation run once per idempotency key: keys scoped to their caller, request fingerprints, the response kept and replayed, three states with an expiring in-progress one, and stores on a port, with adapters for Doctrine DBAL and the Symfony cache under a Symfony lock, for HTTP APIs, Messenger handlers, payment webhooks and forms sent twice

suggest.doctrine/dbal: To keep the keys in a table
suggest.psr/cache: To keep the keys in a cache pool
suggest.symfony/lock: To keep the keys in a cache pool, with an atomic reservation
suggest.symfony/messenger: To handle a received message once per key
